name: Folio
longDescription:
Folio is a browser extension for chromium (Edge, Chrome, Brave) which allows customization of the new tab page.
 It was originally created for personal use because browser new tabs have too much junk on them.
aiExplanation: Mostly vibe-coded, with some modification by me

name: Pynugget
longDescription: Pynugget is a python-based in-browser alternative to [scratch](https://scratch.mit.edu/). It supports assets and shareable project files!
aiExplanation: Mostly vibe-coded, with some modification by me

name: Markdown Editor+
longDescription: A better markdown (.md) editor for you. Works as a PWA on Edge and Chrome and supports opening files directly!

name: Eztools
shortDescription: All the tools you'll ever need.
longDescription: A collection of tools to replace my browser's 'tools' bookmarks folder. I technically didn't CODE this, I sort of designed it in Framer.

name: My Website
longDescription: My website with my portfolio, info, and relative links.

name: Movie List
shortDescription: Most of the movies I've watched, ranked
longDescription: I got bored of using Apple Notes to store my movie ranking lists, so I had AI write this website. It uses an API to try and get data about the movie. Just don't use dates in the names :D - feel free to fork it on Github if you want to make your own!
aiExplanation: I used AI to make the site. List by me.

name: Project Graveyard
shortDescription: For all those things that don't make it here.
longDescription: An editor and viewer for project graveyards - websites with lots of dead projects displayed for all to see. Here's mine if anyone wants to know: https://tinyurl.com/ProjectGraveyard14910

name: Keyframe Function Editor
shortDescription: A simple editor for creating and editing keyframe functions.
longDescription: A keyframe function editor. It allows you to create and edit keyframe functions for use in animations, game dev, and other applications. AI made it in about 10 minutes, and I edited it a bit. Designed for game development and such applications.

name: File Sorter
shortDescription: Sort files into folders by type
longDescription: A simple tool: press a button, select a folder, and then the folder is sorted by file extension. It doesn't touch any of the folders that were previously there.
